description: React component for an autocomplete selector used in Mattermost's web application, providing suggestions for channels, users, or options with customizable list components and focus handling.

classes.name: AutocompleteSelector
classes.description: React.PureComponent implementing an autocomplete input with suggestion list, handling focus, selection, and input changes.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change events, updating the component state with the new input value.

methods.name: handleSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an item, resets input, calls external callback, and blurs suggestion box.

methods.name: setSuggestionRef
methods.description: Sets the reference to the suggestion box DOM element.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates state, and triggers external focus toggle if provided.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, updates state, and triggers external focus toggle if provided.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the autocomplete component with label, suggestion box, and optional help text.
